t1: Bottom frame
Platform common
MS channel, RHS or formed sections to the signed structural drawing
Final member sizes come from your project's structural design, not from a nominal section
Bottom stiffeners
Platform common
RHS, channel or angle stiffeners to the approved floor grid
Spacing follows partitions, bunk posts and openings; site cutting needs approval
Floor frame
Product-specific
Semi-permanent: RCC or approved slab. Relocatable: steel joists with cement board or marine-ply class deck
Each block declares its own floor family; dormitory and wet blocks differ
Top frame and corner posts
Platform common
Bolted MS/RHS panel frame, container modules or light PEB blocks as selected
The selected system decides the frame, so confirm it before fabrication
Roof and roof stiffeners
Product-specific
Insulated PPGI/PPGL sheet or sandwich-panel roof, defined slope, flashing, gutters
Build-up is coordinated with monsoon drainage and heat gain
Exterior walls
Product-specific
GI/PPGI cladding with liner, or nominal 40-80 mm PUF, EPS or mineral-wool sandwich panel
These are alternatives; the panel is selected per block and project brief
Interior walls and ceiling
Product-specific
Dry areas: prelaminated or cement board. Wet and canteen areas: washable moisture-tolerant board or approved liner
Wet areas are not represented by a dry-room lining
Wall and roof insulation
Product-specific
Nominal 40-80 mm PUF, EPS or mineral-wool class
Thickness is confirmed per order against climate and fire strategy
Floor base and finish
Product-specific
Dry blocks: steel deck with cement board or slab. Wet areas: cementitious or RCC base with waterproofing and falls
Wet-area falls and drainage must be fixed early, not on site
Lifting and handling
Common
Designed MS lifting hooks or lugs matched to the completed unit weight
Handle only by the approved lifting drawing
Welding and fabrication
Common
Welded MS fabrication with cleaned joints, safe edges and dimensional inspection
Coating touch-up is completed before panel closure and dispatch
Painting and coating
Common
One red-oxide primer coat plus two anti-rust enamel coats on prepared MS
Coastal or chemical exposure may need an upgraded system, confirmed at quotation
